name: MAX protein bar
ingredients_raw: Protein Blend (30%) (Soy Nuggets, Whey Protein Concentrate, Calcium Caseinate, Soy Concentrate), Dietary Fiber (17%) (Fructooligosacharide), Dark Compound No Added Sugar (19%) (Maltitol, Edible Vegetable Fat (Hydrogenated). Cocoa Solids, Milk Solids, Emulsifier (Soy Lecithin)), Maltitol, Cranberries (7%), Brown Rice Crispy, Rice Bran Oil. Strawberry Preserve (6%) (No Added Sugar), Whole Grain Rolled Oats (5.5%), Yogurt Powder Humectant (Glycerine), Flaxseeds, Emulsifier (Soy Lecithin), Soy Protein Isolate, Binding Agent (Guar Gum), Salt and Citric Acid. Antioxidants (Vitamin C), Added Vitamins and Minerals.
